description: This Dart source file defines the main application widget 'NewsApp' for a Flutter app, including theme setup, route configuration, biometric authentication gating via '_BiometricGate', and navigation handling for various screens like home, saved news, device token, notification test, and reading articles.

classes.description: State class that manages biometric authentication logic, app lifecycle, and re-authentication.
